fund_name: Tata Small Cap Fund Direct Growth
nav:
Tata Small Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Tata Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 29 Jun 1995. Chandraprakash Padiyar is the Current Fund Manager of Tata Small Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹2,17,682 Cr and the Latest  as of 27 Jul 2026 is ₹43.59.
The Tata Small Cap Fund Direct Growth is rated Very High risk. Minimum SIP Investment is set to ₹100. Minimum Lumpsum Investment is ₹5,000. Exit load of 0.50%, if redeemed within 30 days.
